$comment: Generated by bin/build-tokens.mjs. Keys are the Figma names. value is the dark theme, light the light one (theme variables only), alias and lightAlias the primitive each points at. lightSource is rost when registry/light.json sets the light value instead of Figma. source is figma, or rost for Rost's own.

effect/lock-frame.note: LAYER_BLUR "Lock frame": a locked thumbnail. Figma ties it to spacing/base-8 (16), and its blur radius is twice CSS's.

effect/menu.note: BACKGROUND_BLUR "Menu": frosted glass, standard radius (nav, hero cards).

effect/menu-lg.note: "Menu" frosted glass, large radius (case-study hero and island backgrounds).

motion/duration/base.note: Something small moving: the 16px slide of a Projects or Testimonials row.

motion/duration/fast.note: A colour or opacity change on hover, a tooltip appearing.

motion/duration/slow.note: Something big moving: the nav sliding, a banner going away.

motion/duration/slower.note: Content arriving on scroll on the portfolio site.

motion/easing/arrive.note: Content arriving, with a long soft finish.

motion/easing/in-out.note: For things that loop: a pulse, the scroll hint bobbing.

motion/easing/move.note: Something moving from one place to another.

motion/easing/out.note: Starts fast, settles. The row slide.

motion/easing/spring.note: A small overshoot, for things that assemble. Use it rarely.

motion/easing/standard.note: CSS's own ease. The default for fades and colour.

spacing/layout/hero-height.note: The case-study hero (Hero Media). Made in code on 2026-10-19.

typography/subtitle/font-size.note: Old name for typography/sub-title/font-size. The accounting app and the portfolio site still use it.
